# Radoslav Radev Recommends Minimum 15 Pull-Ups, Minimum 20 Dips And 30 Push-Ups In A Row As Preparation To Start Learning The Planche

Radoslav Radev recommends minimum 15 pull-ups, minimum 20 dips, and minimum 30 push-ups in a row as the preparation to start learning the planche, and says that around these numbers is a good amount of preparation. [src: vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 00:30]

## Details

- He says the first and really important thing is the preparation of minimum 15 pull-ups, minimum 20 dips, and minimum 30 push-ups in a row. [src: vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 00:30]
- People without this preparation lack the foundation of raw strength and lose a lot of time struggling on the tuck planche, not because of a bad program or technique but because they do not have the raw strength. [src: vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 00:34]
- Around these numbers is a good amount of preparation to start learning the planche. [src: vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 01:11]
- He says many people think they need handstand, handstand push-ups, muscle-ups, 50, 60 push-ups in a row, or 30, 40 dips in a row, and they waste a lot of time building foundation with weighted pull-ups and weighted dips while still thinking they are not ready for planche. [src: vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 01:16]
- He says it is actually not about the preparation but about the other things that you need. [src: vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 01:37]

## Evidence

- vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 00:30 (Radoslav Radev): "the first and really important thing guys is the preparation the preparation of minimum 15 pull-ups minimum 20 dips and 30 push-ups in a row"
- vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 00:34 (Radoslav Radev): "the people that don't have this preparation they start learning the planche and they don't have the foundation of the row strength and they losing a lot of time because they're struggling on the third planche"
- vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 01:11 (Radoslav Radev): "around these numbers is good amount of preparation to start learning the planche"
- vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 01:16 (Radoslav Radev): "most of you guys i know you think you need handstand handstand push-up muscle ups you need 50 60 push-ups in a row or 30 40 dips in a row"
- vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 01:22 (Radoslav Radev): "i know a lot of people who wasting a lot of time to build the right foundation and they doing weighted pull-ups weighted dips and they still thinking that they're not ready for planche"
- vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 01:37 (Radoslav Radev): "actually it's not about the preparation it's about the other things that you need"
